newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index falls 9.3 points to 813.5.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index falls 9.3 points to 813.5.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, fell 9.3 points on Thursday to 813.5, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Five of the ten sectoral indices lost, with the construction index losing the most, down 1.69 percent to 1,003.5 points.
Of the five sectoral indices posting modest gains, the food index rose most, up 1.41 percent to 1,162.4 points.
